# gitlab-gkg-proto

**Tag**: cli

## 简介

Auto-generated gRPC client for the GitLab Knowledge Graph service

## 官网

- 主页: https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/orbit/knowledge-graph
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/gitlab-gkg-proto
